status: Research specification; not a live selector or integration authorization

coverage.principle: Enumerate every eligible occurrence; allocate stage capacity deliberately to recurring families instead of letting marginal beat salience erase them.
coverage.currentResult: No accepted families, so coverage is zero; do not weaken gates to manufacture anchors.

transformations.reduced: Use strongest event position(s) of the canonical family, with original occurrence event times.
transformations.partial: Use a consistent subset of canonical positions; difficulty determines subset size.
transformations.full: Use all trusted occurrence events if interval/burst/capacity constraints pass.
transformations.expanded: Full motif plus independently trusted nearby one-off event actions; never insert a synthetic note or time.
transformations.simulationScope: Current anchor-only simulation explores strength-ranked reduced/partial/full cases, with per-occurrence capacity. It does not implement expanded event/flow scheduling or a global stage optimizer. A full canonical-position consistency policy remains an integration requirement.

collisionRules.sameEvent: One hit may serve several motif/landmark roles; deduplicate exact event identity/time.
collisionRules.overlappingFamilies: Higher prominence first; deterministic family ID tie-break. Record suppressed occurrence rather than silently losing coverage.
collisionRules.landmarkOverlap: Merge provenance for same trusted event; otherwise compare priority within total stage capacity.
collisionRules.lowDemand: Reduced representation and local capacity cap; preserve musical breathing.
collisionRules.tooDense: Reduce/partially represent before rejecting; record failed trust, burst, interval, spatial or capacity constraint.
collisionRules.landing: Locked; research simulation inserts no anchors.
collisionRules.ending: No inserted event may cross the existing hit-window or release boundary.

variation: Recognizable relative timing/event-position identity within anchors; context-dependent representation, event/flow choices and bounded deterministic spatial variation between anchors. No compulsory identical positions, sizes or density.
semanticProductRule: Semantic non-Drop events remain eligible for gameplay/action mapping; motif/event evidence does not redefine semantic Drop classification.
